code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Circle
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.text(5,5.6,'Fingertip core, mount, flex and readout',ha='center',fontsize=12)
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((3.5,1.5),3,3,boxstyle='round,pad=0.1',facecolor='#dddddd',edgecolor='black'))
ax.text(5,4.0,'rigid core',ha='center',fontsize=10)
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((3.4,4.4),3.2,0.5,boxstyle='round,pad=0.05',facecolor='none',edgecolor='black',lw=1.5))
ax.text(5,4.65,'soft skin',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((1.0,1.5),1.2,3,boxstyle='round,pad=0.05',facecolor='none',edgecolor='black',lw=2))
ax.text(1.6,3.0,'finger\nbracket',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.plot([2.2,3.5],[2.2,2.2],'k-',lw=2); ax.plot([2.2,3.5],[3.2,3.2],'k-',lw=2)
ax.text(2.8,2.5,'dovetail+M2',ha='center',fontsize=8,rotation=90)
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((6.5,0.5),2.5,1.5,boxstyle='round,pad=0.05',facecolor='none',edgecolor='black',lw=1.5))
ax.text(7.75,1.5,'readout PCB',ha='center',fontsize=9); ax.text(7.75,1.1,'MCU+CDC',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.plot([6.0,6.5],[2.0,1.5],'k-',lw=1.5); ax.text(6.3,1.9,'flex+ZIF',fontsize=8)
ax.plot([9.0,9.8],[1.2,1.2],'k-',lw=2); ax.text(9.4,1.5,'6-pin',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.text(1.6,0.6,'FIXED: finger',fontsize=9); ax.text(5,0.6,'TIP ASSEMBLY',ha='center',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=120)
